🎯 Executive Summary

💬
Meta Ads — Lead Generation
Delivered 3,553 WhatsApp conversations at ₹104.86 blended CPR across Choolai, Salem, OMR & multi-location (Oct–Jun). June alone added 635 leads at ₹76.91 CPR — the 4 June-launched campaigns are now past learning phase.
🎯
Google PMax — Store Conversions
Google Store Visit delivered 18,610 conversions across 4 locations on ₹1,85,014 spend (Oct–Jun). June alone added 307 PMax store-visit conversions, with Updated Store Visit OMR delivering the most Get Directions of the month.
🔍
Google Search — Consistent Growth
20,205 total search clicks (Oct–Jun). June added 3,035 clicks at 7.58% CTR — the highest monthly Search CTR on record, up from 3.86% in April.
📱
Instagram — Widest Reach
184+ posts reached 45.25L people generating 18,133 results at just ₹3.71 CPR blended. June introduced a new "engagement boost" campaign format alongside 25 individual post boosts and the influencer video campaign.

💡 March 2026 — Key Insights

🚀
Store Visit Expansion
March saw a massive expansion from 1 location (Salem) to 4 locations (Choolai, OMR, Salem, Rest). Total store conversions jumped to 2,227 in one month vs. 507 in Feb.
💰
Cost/Conv Dramatically Improved
The avg cost per store conversion dropped from ₹62.55 in Feb to just ₹10.63 in March — a 83% efficiency gain driven by multi-location scaling.
🏆
Louvers — Highest CTR
The Louvers ad group led search with a 6.08% CTR in March — well above the 4.03% average. This is a strong signal to increase budget allocation here.
📍
Choolai Leads Conversions
Choolai store visit campaign delivered 704 conversions at ₹9.47/conv — the most efficient location. OMR followed closely at 668 conversions.

Google's PMax location structure was consolidated this month from 4 named-location campaigns to 3 (Rest of Locations, Choolai, OMR), so the campaign list above reflects the account's actual full-month export rather than May/June's Salem/Chennai/Outskirts/Puducherry split. Search CTR held strong at 5.96% across the full month. Beyond the 421 tracked store visits, PMax also generated 4,127 "get directions" actions — a strong secondary intent signal not reflected in the headline conversion count.

Across the full month, Choolai (10-Jun) remained the strongest performer — most leads (384) at the lowest CPR (₹34.06). Salem (12-Jun) went inactive partway through the month but still delivered the highest reach (1,09,980) and impressions of any campaign before stopping. Full-month spend landed at ₹49,740 across 934 leads — a blended CPR of ₹53.26, an improvement over June's ₹76.91 CPR. OMR remains the least efficient campaign (₹88.14 CPR) and is a candidate for creative/targeting review.

💡 Key Insights

📉
Oct → Nov: CPR Halved
Adding Salem and Charu WhatsApp campaigns in November cut CPR from ₹128 to ₹51.97 — conversations nearly doubled from 261 to 480 while spend dropped by ₹8,500.
🏆
Dec: Peak Volume Month
December delivered 651 conversations — the highest across all months. Salem New Targeting hit ₹23.48 CPR, the lowest of the entire campaign period.
⚠️
Feb: CPR Spike Across All
CPR worsened in Feb for all existing campaigns — Choolai Main hit ₹153, Salem hit ₹177, OMR New hit ₹210. New relaunched campaigns (Choolai ₹60, Salem ₹35) performed much better.
🗓️
Mar 2026: ResetOff Leads Efficiency
March added 383 leads at ₹111.34 avg CPR. ResetOff Locations is the standout at ₹58.51 CPR — the Custom+Lookalike campaign launched 13 Mar shows promise at ₹106.76 CPR on early spend.

💡 April Instagram — Key Insights (@nextlevelchennai)

🎬
Top Reel — 94 Full Watches
"Design evolves, but great surfaces don't go out of style" (Apr 1) led all reels with 94 complete video watches, 2,117 engagements and 24,190 reach — this creative format works best. Replicate it.
📸
Marble Finish — Best Reach
Marble finish laminates reel hit 33,057 reach — highest of the month — with 2,418 engagements (also #1). High visual appeal drives both reach and engagement simultaneously.
🌐
Tamil Posts Perform on Par
Tamil-language versions (Instagram பதிவு) averaged 22 full video watches vs 28 for English posts — strong local engagement. Continue bilingual boosting strategy for wider Tamil Nadu audience.
💰
Consistent Spend Per Post
Average spend per post was ₹184 — very consistent across 34 posts. Posts with 90+ watch completions had 37% lower CPR vs. posts under 15 completions, confirming video length quality matters.

A second new engagement-boost campaign, "Instagram Rating video" 🆕, ranked #3 overall with 27,379 engagements. Among individual boosted posts, a new post — "Timeless designs begin with..." 🆕 — was the standout with 250 profile visits at the lowest CPR of any post (₹1.56); "Some materials never go out of..." was next-best with 147 visits at ₹2.62. Full-month mix still skews heavily toward engagement-boost campaigns (59% of spend, 99.3% of total results) versus profile-visit posts, consistent with the format shift that began in mid-June. 35 other posts in the export show 0 spend/results (either not boosted this period or fully completed prior boosts).

Strategy & Roadmap

Active Optimisation Plan · Lead Quality Focus

Newest planned and active initiatives for Next Level Decor — Meta Ads objective shift and the new Instagram × Google Search Console connection.

👥
Meta Ads
🎯 Planned — Choolai First
Campaign Objective Shift — "Leads" Instead of "Conversations" · Chennai-Only

Every active campaign is currently optimised for "Maximise number of conversations" — Meta's algorithm chases anyone likely to open a chat, including people who message out of curiosity and never intend to buy. The planned change is to switch the messaging objective to "Maximise number of leads through messaging", with geo-targeting restricted to Chennai only (not the wider location set), paired with the existing AND-gate targeting logic already applied. Choolai is the priority rollout location — it will be the first campaign switched over, with the rest of the Chennai campaigns following once results are validated.

Current Setup
Objective: Maximise number of conversations · optimises purely for chat-opens, no qualification signal fed back to the algorithm
Planned Setup — Choolai (Priority)
Objective: Maximise number of leads through messaging · Geo: Chennai only · AND-gate audience logic stacked on top — algorithm optimises toward people likely to actually convert, not just chat
Learning Phase — Expected Curve
Early days: fewer total leads, slightly higher CPR while Meta's algorithm relearns the audience. Post-learning: lead volume stabilises and quality improves, since delivery is now optimised for genuine lead intent rather than raw chat-opens.
Rollout plan: Switch Choolai first (Chennai-only geo + leads-through-messaging objective) while OMR/Rest of Locations continue on the current "conversations" objective as a control group. Track CPR and lead count through the learning phase (~1–2 weeks), then compare lead quality via sales-team follow-up outcomes before rolling the same setup out to the remaining Chennai campaigns.
📱
Instagram
🔗 Connected
Instagram Now Linked to Google Search Console — New Analysis Channel

The Instagram property has been added as a new source in Google Search Console, alongside the website. This is separate from Instagram's own native insights — GSC will surface how Instagram content and profile links get discovered and referenced through Google's index over time. Going forward, this becomes an additional analysis input on top of Meta's engagement metrics, not a replacement for them.

✅ What's Done
Instagram added as a new property type in Google Search Console (alongside Website, TikTok, X, YouTube options) — connection is live
⏳ Status
"No data available yet — check back within a few days." GSC needs a short indexing window before the first data appears
📋 Next Steps
Once data populates, pull it into a dedicated Instagram-GSC view on the dashboard, alongside the existing Meta/Instagram engagement metrics

💡 Google April — Key Insights

📈
CTR Improvement Continues
April CTR reached 4.32% — up from 4.03% in March and 2.64% in October 2025. Consistent improvement trend.
🏆
Veneer — Breakout Performer
Veneer ad group at 11.72% CTR in April — nearly 3× the overall average. Significantly higher than March's 3.73%. Increase budget here.
📱
Mobile Dominates
93.4% of clicks are mobile (1,080 of 1,156). Ad creatives and landing pages must be fully mobile-optimised.
🔗
Search Partners Drive Volume
Search partners delivered 774 clicks at ₹2.64 CPC vs. Google search's ₹4.45 CPC. Partners are 40% cheaper per click.
